name: mcp-font-split
description: MCP server wrapping cn-font-split for agent-callable font subsetting
author: WenZhimo

scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm run check:smoke
scripts.check:syntax: node --check batch-run.js && node --check scripts/install-cn-font-split-wasm.js && node --check src/font-split.js && node --check src/server.js && node --check src/smoke-test.js && node --check src/mcp-response.js
scripts.check:smoke: npm run smoke:agent-guidance && npm run smoke:runtime-status && npm run smoke:font-inputs -- .font-split-input-inspect && npm run smoke:scan-limits -- .font-split-scan-limits && npm run smoke:organize -- .font-split-organize-input .font-split-organize-output && npm run smoke:batch-run -- .font-split-batch-run-cli .font-split-batch-run-cli-output && npm run smoke:inspect-compact -- .font-split-inspect-compact && npm run smoke:mcp-error && npm run smoke:mcp-schema && npm run smoke:batch-error-mode -- .font-split-error-mode-input .font-split-error-mode-output && npm run smoke:batch-strict -- .font-split-strict-input .font-split-strict-output
